text:
alex: opened PR with a compact migration guide + SDK helpers for structured outputs and tool calls: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712 — needs reviewers for examples and the migration checklist

priya: scanning now. quick Q: are we recommending a single canonical object shape or a small family of shapes? i.e., should SDKs assume `action` + `params` or allow `tool_call` variants?

alex: recommend canonical top-level object: `{type, payload}` for new guides, but keep a legacy section showing how to map older array/union envelopes to it.

marta: added Python + TS snippets for the canonical shape and a tiny normalize util. example in PR: 
```ts
export interface CanonicalResp { type: string; payload?: Record<string, unknown>; }
export function normalizeResp(r: any): CanonicalResp { /* quick checks and parsing */ }
```

danny: CI flagged a broken internal link to /docs/tooling/invoke.md, ci-bot says 404

ci-bot: link-checker: /docs/tooling/invoke.md -> 404 (line 67)

priya: fixed links in a new commit, replaced with /docs/reference/tool-invoke.md and updated permalinks.

alex: add guardrail bullets at top: prefer object, limit nested anyOfs, one explicit tool_call object when calling external tools. keep them short.

marta: wrote guardrails: 
- "Response SHOULD be a JSON object at the top level."
- "When calling a tool, include `tool_call:{name, arguments}` as an object."
- "Avoid top-level unions/arrays; use named lists under properties."

danny: please include a pragmatic parser fallback snippet for truncated or prefixed text (we keep getting partial streams). I pushed a small regex-based extractor in the PR.

marta: added an acceptance checklist for docs reviewers: streaming partial JSON, escaped quotes, and args serialized as strings.

alex: also add a note about argument size limits — recommend <8KB for tool args to avoid KV/cache pressure. include a simple trimming helper.

priya: added changelog line and a short notify list for customers on the watchlist.

deploy-bot: docs build queued after merge; will publish permalinks on success.

alex: plan: merge if CI green and no objections by Monday 09:00 PT. please leave quick reactions if you approve. :rocket:

marta: LGTM — left a minor wording tweak.

danny: LGTM after CI.

priya: will merge once CI clears and notify integrations teams to validate SDK snippets.

alex: thanks all. leaving this open until merge — will ping #eng when published.
